blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) on Monday said it is investigating properties linked to Vice President Sara Duterte and Davao City Rep. Paolo Duterte after discovering that one of their properties in Davao City, declared at around P890,000, could be worth as much as P60 million. NBI director Melvin Matibag himself revealed this during a presentation of the agency’s initial findings on the alleged discrepancies in both Dutertes’ declared property values on their Statements of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth or SALNs.
